avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces midazolam levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative anxiolytic if St. John's Wort is needed

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; increased risk of respiratory depression and oversedation
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use together under any circumstances

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and sedation potentiation
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; separate dosing or discontinue valerian

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly increase midazolam levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive sedation; may require dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive anxiolytic and mild CNS depressant effects
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor for enhanced sedation

caution_supplements.name: Melatonin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive sedative effects may increase drowsiness
caution_supplements.action: Monitor tolerance; dose adjustment may be needed

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases midazolam bioavailability and CNS effects; risk of severe oversedation
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice; maintain avoidance throughout therapy

avoid_foods.name: Pomegranate
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases midazolam levels and duration of action
avoid_foods.action: Avoid or limit consumption; monitor for enhanced sedation if consumed

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay gastric emptying and slow midazolam absorption; minimal clinical impact for IV/IM forms
caution_foods.action: Take oral formulations consistently with or without food; maintain routine

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; impaired cognitive and motor function
caution_foods.action: Advise complete avoidance during midazolam therapy; educate on overdose risk

monitoring_notes: Monitor for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and loss of consciousness, particularly with grapefruit co-ingestion or CNS-depressant supplements. Educate patient on grapefruit avoidance and alcohol interaction risks; reassess CNS function if new supplements or dietary changes are introduced.
